title: Macros
summary: Code that writes code - what macros can do that functions cannot, macro_rules! with fragment specifiers, repetition with $(...),*, several rules in one macro, recursion, hygiene, exporting macros, and a look at derive and procedural macros.

cards.a: The `expr` fragment keeps `2 + 3` as one expression, so the expansion behaves like `(2 + 3) * (2 + 3)`.

cards.q: What does `$( ... ),*` mean in a macro pattern?
cards.a: The part in brackets may appear any number of times, separated by commas.
